emulator: AVD USKOCI_V5_TEST, 1080x2424 @420 dpi (~412 dp), font scale 1.0, Europe/Belgrade
method: two independent critiques per unit (UX, visual) over the real emulator screenshots; every finding verified by a code-aware skeptic against HEAD; only real && !alreadyFixedAtHead && severity != none count as confirmed

kritika:prijava:ux: The task face at the top is bare over a hairline, no card and no tint, with FactArt facts and "Traži 3 osobe" exactly as the Zadaci card says it.
One green primary per screen; every grey "Pregledaj ponudu" / "Sačuvaj ocenu" carries its reason right under it (01, 03, 04, 07, 08, 09, 20, 26), and 07/08 add the one link that fixes it.

A missing price never looks like an amount ("Cena nije navedena", "Cena još nije upisana", "Cena nije ispravna"); every amount keeps RSD; per-person and total pricing are explained with the computed total (05, 06).
Orange appears only on the rating stars and the fact pictograms; the primary is dark green everywhere.
Success (SuccessMark + one way on), loading (skeleton + words), error (retry) and unknown outcome (warm notice, preserved choice, "Proveri…") are all present and honest.

Rating: word hints under the stars ("Izaberi ocenu", "Vrlo dobro"), chips greyed once three are chosen with the reason, busy spinner in the button, saved view read-only with "Sačuvana ocena se ne menja".
One time format throughout ("26. sep · 10:00–12:00") and "Po vremenu u Srbiji." in the time sheet; field labels are plain questions with no eyebrows; the optional note is marked "nije obavezna".
A TOTAL-priced task locks the people count as a sentence ("Dolaze 3 osobe") instead of a dead stepper.
kritika:zadaci:ux: Root tab chrome is right: one header (profile · mark · bell), no title copy, and the inset tab bar with the pale-green "Zadaci" selection always shows where you are.

The search pill says the whole search in two lines of plain Serbian ("Svi zadaci / Bilo kada · Dodaj uslove"); "Uslovi pretrage" is green and the orange "+" is the screen's single orange accent; chips read as plain toggles (Danas, Sutra, Ove nedelje, Na licu mesta, Na daljinu).
Price truth holds on card and pin: "6.000 RSD ukupno" keeps currency and basis; a task asking for offers is a grey word ("Ponude" / "Tražim ponude" in the cold-boot reference), never an amount.

Selection is dark green with white words (the chosen pill), the unselected pill is white with green money text; FactArt for "Traži 2 osobe"; the orange star and the honest "4,5 (2)" rating; the poster's real name and no invented data.

Touch targets are sound (48 dp header buttons, × on the card, filter and +, tab items; zoom capsule and chips reach 48 with hit slop); no text under 12 px; map labels are Latin ("Beograd", "Srbija", "Crna Gora").
Accessible names are meaningful: the whole card reads as "Otvori zadatak: title, price, place, time, places"; "Zatvori pregled zadatka"; "Uvećaj/Umanji mapu"; "Mapa približnih lokacija Zadatka".
kritika:zadaci:visual: Header trio (profile · mark · bell), search pill and the two chrome circles sit on one 44/48 system in a clean 16 dp column; the pill's two lines (bold where, muted when) and the green magnifier are exactly the app's voice.

Colour discipline holds: dark green price pin, green magnifier and pale-green selected tab; orange appears only as the "+" glyph, the people FactArt and the rating star, with no orange fill on the screen.

The pin card is bare and honest: 20/700 Inter title kept clear of the ×, place · time in the fact colour, "6.000 RSD" with currency and the basis "ukupno" beside it, "Traži 2 osobe" with the FactArt people icon, poster with avatar and the real rating with its count, no photo, no card inside a card.
The bottom bar shows where you are (Zadaci filled pale green, label green; the others grey) and matches the reference look.
Zoom capsule with its inset hairline divider and the credits ride together above the card rather than being covered.
kritika:prijava:visual: The task face is bare over a hairline (no card, no tint) with the same 16-px FactArt pin / calendar / users facts and the same "Traži 3 osobe" wording as the Zadaci sheet card, so the composer visibly belongs to the same app.

Colour discipline holds: the green primary with a white label, the grey disabled button always with its reason under it, quiet green text actions; on the rating screens the orange stars are the only orange, on the composer orange appears only as FactArt accents.

The stepper reads its state honestly: the − glyph is muted at 1, the + is muted at the limit, and an over-count gets the red border plus the red note; the invalid price gets red border, red hint and the summary "Cena nije ispravna".
Money never loses its currency ("4.500 RSD", "18.000 RSD ukupno"); "Tražim ponude" and "Cena nije navedena" are drawn as labels, never as amounts.
Chips are consistent 48-dp hairline pills; the selected state (light-green fill, green border, check, green bold label) is clear, and the three-tag limit reason appears exactly when needed.
The warm warnSoft notice is the same in the composer (13, 14, 15) and the rating (23); the SuccessMark and the success headline are identical in 16 and 24.
The time sheet stacks its fields two per row in hairline boxes with a plain "Po vremenu u Srbiji." note and one green primary plus a quiet alternative.
A very long title wraps to three lines with an ellipsis and nothing is clipped; the long primary label "Pregledaj uslove i uredi novu ponudu" fits at 412 dp.
Loading, error, unknown-outcome and saved states all exist and are drawn; nothing is a dead end.
kritika:objava:ux: Every inner screen is arrow + title of the content with no eyebrow and no orientation copy; the bar, spacing and type match the Zadaci reference.
Money and time are right everywhere: "4.500 RSD" with "ukupno", "Cena nije navedena" never looks like an amount, "27. sep · 10:00–12:00" in the one time format.
The publish footer is exemplary in the ready and blocked states: one green action, a grey one that says why ("Prvo reši ono što još treba."), and an honest caption of what the tap does.
FactArt carries the whole unit (pin, calendar, people, eye, lock, camera); the "Vide svi" / lock groups read instantly and no category or skill is shown.
Loading, error and empty states are real StateViews with a clear retry; photo removal asks first; an unconfirmed send has visible exits and the privacy notice with the lock is always on screen.
The place step is clean: no box inside a box, groups with hairlines, the sticky save with its reason, and the country/mode row as one tappable line.
Copy is "ti", gender-free and free of "server" wording across all 23 scenes.
kritika:objava:visual: The preview card is the one card look done right: hairline cardCompact, title in ink, green amount with its currency and the "ukupno" basis under it; a missing price is a grey two-line "Cena nije navedena" that never looks like an amount (02); at large text the value slot stacks under the title cleanly (09).

One time format ("27. sep · 10:00–12:00") and FactArt for every fact: green pin, orange calendar, orange people, eye/lock for the groups, camera for photos, lock on the privacy note; no phosphor icon leaks into content rows.
Inner bars are exactly arrow + title of the content, with no eyebrow; after publishing the title becomes "Objavljeno" (04).

Colour discipline holds across all 23 scenes: green primary with white label, orange only as the map pin, the "Još treba" dots and FactArt accents, one orange fill per screen; the grey publish is a wash with a hairline and a reason line, not a faded green.
"Još treba" rows are white 56-dp hairline rows with dot and chevron, not cards; Mesto/Vide svi/Privatni podaci use the same section-header-with-quiet-action pattern as the rest of the app.

Photos: 36-px corner remove inside a 48-px target, dashed edges for sending/unconfirmed tiles, a real confirm sheet (green title, destructive fill, quiet cancel), and an honest privacy notice always present; the empty, loading and error states all exist and read clearly (20, 21, 22).
Footers are pinned with a hairline top on all three screens and the publish button keeps its label with a spinner while working (03).
kritika:dodaci:ux: The 'umesto 5.500 RSD' / 'umesto 26. sep · 17:00–19:00' lines under a proposal (09, 10) make a change legible in one glance, and every amount carries RSD, even inside the price input (11).
Cancellation step 2 (12) quotes the person's own reason, states the consequences before the single red button, and the X reads 'Odustani od radnje': a safe, honest destructive flow.
The answer composer (03) shows exactly which question is being answered, offers a close X, and warns that an answer does not change the task's terms.
Loading, error and empty states are complete and identical across all four surfaces (05/06, 15, 22, 25/27) with one green retry and the grey FactArt.
The group intro sentence (23) steers price, personal terms and problems to the private Dogovor, and the back label is 'Nazad na Dogovor' for the screen reader.
The Q&A owner view (02) separates 'Čekaju odgovor · 2', public answers, 'Sklonjena pitanja' and 'Prethodne verzije' with a plain warning that old answers do not describe current terms.
No 'server' wording, no gendered forms, no card inside a card, and one time format ('26. sep · 17:00–19:00', '24. sep · 12:02') across the unit; group messages of today correctly show time only.
kritika:dodaci:visual: The Izmene fact rows are the best-behaved surface of the unit: FactArt + muted label + value, a green amount that keeps its currency, one 'umesto' line and a single filled green primary (10) with every other command white or text.
The pill composer is one family across Q&A and Grupa: grey send when empty, green when it can go, note lines above it, and the reply-to header with an X (03) is a clean adoption of the Poruke look.

State handling is consistent and honest: amber insets for an unconfirmed outcome (13, 20) with one green primary and a quiet stop; grey art for errors (06, 22, 27) and green for empties; SuccessMark on 14; a destructive step drawn as an outlined red button, never a filled one (12).
The group bubbles read as Poruke: name in green only on the first message of a turn, tight run spacing, own messages in soft green without a border, 82 % max width.
The location screen's one orange is a dot (16) and the map's pin (18); the people FactArt stays an icon, so the accent rule holds on every scene.

verdicts.kritika:prijava:ux: The unit is close to done — facts, states and the green/orange discipline are right — but the sheet header with the × dropped under the title (both sheets), the self-contradicting helper on the priceless task and the hollow double-hairline band in the pending states need fixing before the emulator pass is signed off; the \"Slanje\" and \"Ocena: greška\" scenes have no picture and remain unjudged.
verdicts.kritika:zadaci:ux: The Zadaci tab as photographed is coherent and on-brand (chrome, search pill, chips, honest price and selection colours) but not done: a selected pin hides a clustered second task, the list vanishes without a trace behind the pin card, and the pin card reshapes the task differently from the list card, plus three low polish items — and only one state (ready, one pin chosen) was photographed, so loading/error/empty, the full list with the \"Mapa\" pill, the search panel and \"Bez tačke na mapi\" remain unchecked.
verdicts.kritika:zadaci:visual: The Zadaci tab already reads as one premium USKOČI screen; the only real defect is the SDK's stray English attribution "i" button, and the rest is rhythm and edge polish.
verdicts.kritika:prijava:visual: Fix first the sheet header whose × wraps under the title (10, 11) and the contradictory missing-price sentence (07), then the double hairline, the wrap-dependent footer, the card-shaped skeletons and the calendar-on-time-fields; the rest of the unit already reads as one app beside the Zadaci tab.
verdicts.kritika:objava:ux: The unit has the right bones and honest states, but two screens would confuse a real person today (the duplicate check buttons with no primary on the unconfirmed review, and the \"saved, now tick and save again\" footer on Mesto zadatka), and a handful of vocabulary, pin-semantics and gallery-fidelity fixes are needed before this passes.
verdicts.kritika:objava:visual: The unit looks like one premium USKOČI screen family and obeys the colour, card, icon and price rules, but it is not done: the unconfirmed-outcome review draws two refresh buttons with no primary and mixed tones, three grey commands lack their reason, the failed photo and not-editable place states have no error tone, the coarse map draws a precise pin under \"približno područje\", and two gallery scenes (photo footer, saved place) do not draw what the product draws, so their emulator pictures prove nothing; note also that every review screenshot stops at Mesto, so Privatni podaci, Detalji, the three-tile Fotografije row, Prijave and the 320-dp/1.3 wraps the report asked to check are not in these pictures.
verdicts.kritika:dodaci:ux: The unit is complete and honest in its states, but its recovery and Izmene flows speak in process jargon ('radnja', 'zahtev', 'identifikator', 'Pregledaj …') instead of plain commands, the photo strip scene was never captured, and the location scenes are moot pending the owner's removal.
verdicts.kritika:dodaci:visual: Visually the unit is close to one premium app, but it cannot pass yet: the photo row was never photographed, the time fields wear calendar icons, and the group conversation sits on a different gutter, anchoring and refresh pattern from both Poruke and the other four screens.

confirmed.problem: In both bottom sheets ("Ovo šalješ", "Tačan termin") the × close button is drawn on its own row UNDER the green title, left-aligned, leaving an empty right half of the header. The exit is not where a person looks for it and the header looks broken.
confirmed.expected: Title and × on one row: title left, × at the right edge, the same way the inner bar is arrow + title. Both sheets share the component, so one fix covers both.
confirmed.rule: Flow exits (Back/X) visible where expected; one chrome look across the app.
confirmed.fixHint: src/ui/product/ProductSheet.tsx lines 143-146 and s.heading (line 162). The heading is the sticky header of BottomSheetScrollView (stickyHeaderIndices=[0]); the sticky wrapper is not stretched to the sheet width, so the title with flex:1 takes the full line and the × wraps. Give s.heading width:'100%' / alignSelf:'stretch' (and the title flexShrink:1, numberOfLines if needed), then re-check both sheets on the emulator.

verdict.reason: Confirmed in both screenshots (10 and 11): the green title sits on one line and the 48 dp × is alone on the next row, left-aligned, with the right half of the header empty. Confirmed in code, though the fixHint's cause is wrong: ProductSheet passes stickyHeaderIndices={[0]} to BottomSheetScrollView (an RN ScrollView), and RN 0.86.3's ScrollViewStickyHeader.js (lines 297-308) transfers the sticky child's own style to its wrapper Animated.View and re-clones the child with style {flex: 1} only. s.heading's flexDirection 'row' therefore lands on the wrapper, while the View that actually holds the title and the × becomes a default column and stacks them; width '100%' on s.heading would be moved to the wrapper the same way and would fix nothing. This is shared product chrome, not gallery chrome or fixture data: the same sheets render in ApplicationComposerPresentation.tsx (lines 175, 355) in the real flow, and every titled ProductSheet in the app (~14 call sites: calendar, availability, location, legal, ActionSheet, ConfirmSheet, PublicProfileSheet, marketplace filter, support) has the same broken header since the sticky heading landed in 5ccdea07 (round 5c, 2026-09-24). git diff-tree b4531ef4..3ec4e6f1 touches no src/ file, so it is present at HEAD. No test pins the heading and Jest's ScrollView mock does not apply the sticky wrapper, so only the emulator shows it. High, not blocker: the × still works and drag/Back also close, but the exit is not where a person looks, a whole 48 dp row is wasted, and it breaks 'one chrome look' and 'flow exits where expected' on every sheet in the app.
verdict.fix: In ProductSheet.tsx line 143, keep the outer sticky <View style={s.heading}> for the surface background and paddingBottom (its style is what RN moves to the sticky wrapper) and nest a new <View style={s.headingRow}> inside it that holds the title (flex: 1, numberOfLines optional) and the × Press; add s.headingRow = { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: sys.space.md } and drop flexDirection/alignItems/gap from s.heading (line 162), then re-check 'Ovo šalješ' and 'Tačan termin' on the emulator since Jest cannot reproduce the sticky wrapper.

confirmed.problem: The sheet header is broken into two rows: the green title ("Ovo šalješ", "Tačan termin") stands alone on the first line and the × close button sits UNDER it on the left, in a light-grey circle. The header therefore takes ~110 dp and the × looks like a stray control, not the sheet's close.
confirmed.expected: One header row: title on the left, × on the right end of the same line (as the × on the Zadaci task card sits top-right), so the sheet body starts right under a single heading line.
confirmed.rule: Inner surface = title + one close control on one row; one premium look across scenes; no dead-looking controls.
confirmed.fixHint: src/ui/product/ProductSheet.tsx: s.heading is a flex row with title flex:1 and the × after it, but it is rendered as the sticky element (stickyHeaderIndices={[0]}) inside BottomSheetScrollView and on the emulator the row collapses to a column. Check the sticky wrapper on Android (give the heading an explicit width:'100%' / alignSelf:'stretch', or wrap title+× in an inner row View inside the sticky element); re-shoot 10 and 11.

verdict.reason: Confirmed in both screenshots (title alone on line 1, × in a grey circle under it at the left, ~2 rows of header) and in the code. ProductSheet.tsx:143 renders <View style={s.heading}> (flexDirection:'row', alignItems:'center', gap) as child 0 of BottomSheetScrollView with stickyHeaderIndices={[0]} (line 139). RN 0.86.3's ScrollViewStickyHeader (node_modules/react-native/Libraries/Components/ScrollView/ScrollViewStickyHeader.js lines 297-308) moves child.props.style onto its own Animated.View wrapper and clones the child with style {flex:1} ("We transfer the child style to the wrapper"), so the View that actually holds the title and the × loses the row direction and lays out as a column: title, then the 48-dp × pill below at the left. This is JS-level RN behaviour, not Android-specific. It is product UI, not gallery chrome: the same ProductSheet is used by ApplicationComposerPresentation.tsx:175 ("Tačan termin") and :355 ("Ovo šalješ") and by every other titled sheet in the app, so every sheet header is broken. Not fixed at HEAD: no commit touches ProductSheet.tsx between b4531ef4 and HEAD and `git diff --stat b4531ef4 HEAD -- src` is empty. The hint's width:'100%'/alignSelf:'stretch' variant would NOT work because the child's style is replaced wholesale; the inner-row variant is correct. Severity high because it is the one shared sheet engine (every titled sheet), wastes ~60 dp and makes the × look like a stray control, though the × still works (not a blocker).
verdict.fix: In src/ui/product/ProductSheet.tsx keep the outer <View style={s.heading}> as the sticky element (its paddingBottom + backgroundColor are what RN moves onto the sticky wrapper, which is desired) but wrap the title T and the × Press in a new inner <View style={s.headingRow}> inside it, and split the style at line 162 into heading: { paddingBottom: sys.space.md, backgroundColor: sys.color.surface } and headingRow: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: sys.space.md } (title keeps flex:1, close unchanged). Do not use width:'100%'/alignSelf:'stretch' on s.heading, it cannot survive the {flex:1} style replacement; existing sheets.test.tsx lookups by accessibilityRole 'header' and the 'Zatvori' label are unaffected. Re-shoot gallery scenes 10 and 11 and one other titled sheet (e.g. the Dogovor menu) on the emulator.

verdict.reason: Confirmed in the picture and in the code. Screenshot 23 shows "Ukloni" as a solid brick-red fill with a white label under a green title and a green text "Odustani"; screenshot 18 shows the error line in the same red. In code, ConfirmSheet.tsx:121 sets `danger: { backgroundColor: sys.color.danger }` (#963F34) and the label stays `onGreen` (white); `T` tone `danger` (Text.tsx:33) reads the same token, so the fill and the error text are one colour, as the finding says. It is product UI, not a gallery artifact: src/app/(app)/fotografije-zadatka.tsx:174-175 asks the identical question with `tone: 'danger'`, and the round-6 objava spec (r6-specs/objava.spec.json:184) asked for exactly that; the gallery scene only replays it. Not handled at HEAD (3ec4e6f1 has the same line; the fill entered with 8e099ab2, "one sheet engine", 2026-09-24). The finding is a palette-discipline question, not a usability defect: the fill is deliberate (comment at lines 117-118), reaches about 6.9:1 (white on #963F34, verified), and is used consistently by every destructive confirm in the app through this one shared component (about 15 call sites: close account, withdraw application, leave conversation, discard edits, remove photo). What makes it a real system inconsistency is that the system's other two destructive drawings are NOT fills: V2Action `kind='destructive'` is danger text on white (V2Action.tsx:19, 61, citing the forensic rule "one green fill, every other action white with a coloured label") and ActionSheet `destructive` is danger text on a dangerSoft icon well (ActionSheet.tsx:65, 80, 85). So ConfirmSheet is the one place a fourth fill colour exists. The owner rules as given grant one green primary and orange as the only accent fill and say nothing about red; no owner decision on red fills exists in the memory notes, the master plan or the design-system docs (an older 2026-09-08 synthesis sketch shows "danger fill" for Otkaži Dogovor, and the r6-dogovor-dodaci report deferred a "danger fill" for V2Action to the lead; neither is an owner decision). A green "Ukloni" would be wrong (green reads as safe), so the two honest options are the current red fill or the V2Action destructive look; that choice is the owner's, hence low.
verdict.fix: Ask the owner one question: may a destructive confirm be the one red fill in the app? If the answer is no, change ConfirmSheet.tsx:121 from `danger: { backgroundColor: sys.color.danger }` to `danger: { backgroundColor: sys.color.surface, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: sys.color.danger }`, draw the label in `sys.color.danger` instead of `s.onFilled` when `danger` (and give the busy ActivityIndicator that colour in the same branch), which mirrors V2Action kind='destructive' and keeps the same 6.9:1 contrast; if the answer is yes, record it in the tokens.ts colour comment as the one granted red fill (destructive confirm only) so the next audit does not re-raise it.

verdict.reason: Confirmed in all three screenshots (13, 14, 15): under the task face there is a full-width hairline, ~30 dp of empty white, then a second hairline before "Ukupna ponuda". In the code it is exactly what the finding names: `s.task` (line 404) draws `borderBottomWidth: 1` with `paddingBottom: lg`, the ScrollView content adds `gap: lg` (24), and the first child of `SentFacts` is `ProductFact prominent`, whose `s.price` style in src/ui/product/ProductDetails.tsx line 300 adds `marginTop: 8` and its own `borderTopWidth: 1` — so 24 + 8 = 32 dp of nothing framed by two lines. It is not a gallery artifact: dizajn-prijava.tsx only feeds `pending/uncertain/reset` into the real `ApplicationComposerPresentation`, and the route renders the same branch. It is limited to the `locked` branch (lines 296-300: pending, uncertain, and the known-refusal `reset` state). The `confirmed` branch (SuccessMark + title + copy before `sentFacts`) and the review sheet (`reviewTask` text before `sentFacts`) put text between the two lines, so they do not show it. Not fixed at HEAD 3ec4e6f1 (lines 296-300 and 404 unchanged). Severity low: purely visual, nothing misleading or blocked, a two-line change — but it does violate the "hairline and air, never empty frames" rule on three real states of a screen where the person is checking whether something went wrong. Of the two proposed fixes, dropping the task's bottom border is the worse one: it would leave 24 + 24 + 8 = 56 dp of air above the price's own line against 24 dp above the task face, still asymmetric; the heading is the right fix and matches the `DetailSection` / task-detail pattern (hairline, air, heading, content). Reuse the vocabulary the footer already uses in the editable state ("Tvoja ponuda") rather than inventing a judgement like "Odbijena ponuda": in the reset scene the refusal is "Zadatak je promenjen", not a rejection by the requester, and the state is already said by the notice and the button. verdict.reason: Half of the finding is real in both the picture and the code, half is a design judgment against a documented choice. (1) Width: in 18-galerija-prijava-greska.png the green "Pokušaj ponovo" spans x≈53–388 of 891 (~38% of the content width) and in 25-galerija-ocena-jos-nije-dostupna.png "Nazad na Dogovor" spans ≈53–430, both left-hugging, while every other brandAction on the same two screens is full width (footer "Otvori moje prijave" in 16, footer "Nazad na Dogovor" in 24, sheet "Pošalji ovu Prijavu" in 10). The cause is exactly the hinted line: `s.state = { …, alignItems: 'flex-start' }` at StateView.tsx:57 makes the V2Action (Press: flexDirection row, justifyContent center, no alignSelf/width of its own; brandAction sets only colour/height/radius) size itself to its label. This is not a gallery artifact: the scenes are the real `ComposerUnavailable` (ApplicationComposerPresentation.tsx:117-122) and `AgreementReviewPresentation` (lines 80-81, 134-135) with fixture data, and the same StateView is used app-wide since 3beed3b0 (Dogovori, Moji zadaci, 40+ call sites), so the hugging button is the app's whole empty/error-state look, and at HEAD it is unchanged (the r6 sweep only flagged its padding scale, not alignment). No owner rule literally says "full width", so it is a consistency nit, not a rule break: severity low. (2) Art: the grey "i" in 18 is `DEFAULT_ART.error = 'info'` drawn `muted` (StateView.tsx:14, 44), which the component documents as deliberate ("a quiet sign otherwise"; "Error and offline draw the picture grey"), the r6 prijava spec asked for exactly this StateView error with no art, the title carries accessibilityRole alert and the copy plus "Pokušaj ponovo" already say what went wrong; FactArt has no failure/warning kind at all (27 kinds, none of them), so "an error art that says something went wrong" would mean a new shared FactArt kind for a low finding. Scene 25 is kind="empty" with art="star", not an error, so the "i" criticism does not apply to it. The proposed alignment fix is consistent with the shared system (one `s.state` token change, the 80 px art well keeps its explicit width and stays left, texts stay left-aligned, the quiet action becomes a centred full-width text action exactly like "Izmeni ponudu" under "Pošalji ovu Prijavu" in 10; state-view.test.tsx pins no alignment, so no test changes).
verdict.fix: In src/ui/system/StateView.tsx line 57 change `s.state` from `alignItems: 'flex-start'` to `alignItems: 'stretch'` (or drop the key) so the one green action and the quiet action fill the content width like every footer primary while the 80 px art well and the left-aligned title/body keep their place. Leave the muted "i" as the documented quiet sign; where a screen has a subject, pass it instead of adding a FactArt kind (ComposerUnavailable: `art="offers"`, the review error: `art="star"`), as Dogovori already does with `art="agreements"`.

verdict.reason: Confirmed as a capture gap, not a product or gallery defect. The folder has no 12-*.png and no 28-*.png, labels.json records "Galerija: Slanje" with shot null and stops at 27 entries, and the untracked montage R6_PRIJAVA_b4531ef4.png holds 26 scenes plus the index (its caption "27 scenes" counts the index). Both scenes exist at HEAD in src/app/dizajn-prijava.tsx (line 111 'slanje' = composer busy+pending; line 127 'ocena-greska' = review kind 'error'). Cause 1, "Ocena: greška": 00-index.png is the fully scrolled list and its last row spans y 2141–2274 px (centre 2208, text ink 2191–2231); gal6.py discovers rows only where n['y'] < 2200 (line 101) and taps only where hit['y'] < 2200 (line 139), so the last row of a 28-row gallery can never be discovered or tapped; a plain re-run misses it again. Cause 2, "Slanje": the label dump recorded for shot 11 is the index list while 11-galerija-tacan-termin.png shows the time sheet, so nodes() returned a tree that was not on the display (the script reads /sdcard/uskoci-ui.xml without clearing it, so a failed uiautomator dump silently returns the previous screen); the following eight searches for the Slanje row read the same wrong tree and the entry was written as a miss. In code both states use the shared system and look predictable: the busy send is a green V2Action with loading (spinner before the kept label "Slanje…", accessibilityState busy, summary row hidden, refresh hidden while pending), and the rating error is StateView kind="error" with the first sentence as title, the rest as body and a green "Ponovo učitaj ocenu" primary, the same component as the captured shot 18 "Prijava: greška". Nothing at HEAD or in the untracked r6-emulator-b4531ef folder supplies the two pictures, so the finding stands, at low severity, as a harness fix plus a re-capture.
verdict.fix: In gal6.py raise the bottom cutoff so a row at the screen's bottom edge counts: use the node's bottom bound (y2 <= 2330, above the gesture bar) instead of centre y < 2200 in both the discovery loop (line 101) and the tap search (line 139); in nodes() (lines 31–32) delete /sdcard/uskoci-ui.xml before each dump and raise or retry when the dump's stdout does not report the file written, so a stale tree can never pass as the live screen. Then re-run the full walk `python gal6.py dizajn-prijava r6-prijava` (a --redo-small run cannot add the undiscovered 28th scene), rebuild the montage with all 28 scenes and correct its caption, and judge 12-galerija-slanje.png (spinner + "Slanje…", no summary, no reason line needed) and 28-galerija-ocena-greska.png (grey art, title "Ocenu trenutno nije moguće učitati.", body, green "Ponovo učitaj ocenu").

The cause is exactly the hinted line: `s.state = { …, alignItems: 'flex-start' }` at StateView.tsx:57 makes the V2Action (Press: flexDirection row, justifyContent center, no alignSelf/width of its own; brandAction sets only colour/height/radius) size itself to its label. No owner rule literally says "full width", so it is a consistency nit, not a rule break: severity low. (2) Art: the grey "i" in 18 is `DEFAULT_ART.error = 'info'` drawn `muted` (StateView.tsx:14, 44), which the component documents as deliberate ("a quiet sign otherwise"; "Error and offline draw the picture grey"), the r6 prijava spec asked for exactly this StateView error with no art, the title carries accessibilityRole alert and the copy plus "Pokušaj ponovo" already say what went wrong; FactArt has no failure/warning kind at all (27 kinds, none of them), so "an error art that says something went wrong" would mean a new shared FactArt kind for a low finding. The proposed alignment fix is consistent with the shared system (one `s.state` token change, the 80 px art well keeps its explicit width and stays left, texts stay left-aligned, the quiet action becomes a centred full-width text action exactly like "Izmeni ponudu" under "Pošalji ovu Prijavu" in 10; state-view.test.tsx pins no alignment, so no test changes).

Avatar 40 + name ... five read-only stars (not pressable, size 28 ...) ... the tags as ONE muted line ... (never chips)"), written to fix the earlier audit finding on the same spec's line 98 that the receipt's tags "look pressable though they are not". verdict.reason: Confirmed in both pictures and in code: 04 shows a naked green tick in the "Zadatak je objavljen." banner (ReviewStatus -> SuccessMark size 40), 16 shows FactArt "check" (filled green disc, white tick) in PhotoStatus. Both are product components with product props (the gallery passes fresh=published, which is what the route passes on a live publication), so it is not a gallery artifact, and src is unchanged between b4531ef4 and 3ec4e6f1. But the finding's diagnosis and fixHint point the wrong way. SuccessMark is the shared system component for "a finished thing, confirmed once" and is used on seven other confirmation surfaces (Prijava poslata 64, Ocena je sačuvana 64, Potvrđen zahtev 64, Dogovor/lokacija CONFIRMED, selection 48, mesto sačuvano 32); "Zadatak je objavljen." is exactly that moment - pregled-zadatka.tsx:407 springs and haptics only when publishedHere and is still on a reopened receipt, pinned by v5-review-screen.test.tsx:671-683. FactArt "check" is the app-wide convention for a static status LINE (LegalDocuments:76, WorkerProfilePresentation:97/217, profil/lokacija:127, PhotoStatus:22). So HEAD already has the split the finding's "expected" asks for; swapping ReviewStatus to FactArt check would delete the unit's one success moment, break the test and diverge from the other seven receipts. The real visible defect is a colour collision: statusDone paints the banner sys.color.greenSoft (#EFF6F0), which is the very colour of SuccessMark's disc (SuccessMark.tsx:38), so the disc vanishes and a 40 px SuccessMark degrades to a bare 20 px phosphor Check that matches neither SuccessMark elsewhere (always on the white screen) nor FactArt. That is why it reads as "a bare tick". mesto-zadatka.tsx:52 (`saved`, greenSoft inset + SuccessMark 32) has the same collision; the gallery's scene 14 does not draw a mark at all (gallery divergence, not product UI). Cosmetic, one banner: low.
verdict.fix: In src/ui/objava/ReviewPresentation.tsx line 216 stop painting the done banner in the disc's own colour - e.g. `statusDone: { backgroundColor: sys.color.surface }` (wash #F2F7F4 would not help, it is nearly the same tint) - so the SuccessMark shows its soft-green disc plus tick exactly as on the Prijava/ocena/podrška receipts; apply the same to `saved` in src/app/(app)/mesto-zadatka.tsx line 52. Keep PhotoStatus on FactArt "check": it is the status-line icon, and keep SuccessMark in ReviewStatus so the published moment still springs and the review-screen test stays green.
